# Third-party notices

## ECDICT

English vocabulary, Chinese meanings, phonetics, exam tags, and frequency
metadata are derived from [skywind3000/ECDICT](https://github.com/skywind3000/ECDICT).

- Pinned commit: `bc015ed2e24a7abef49fc6dbbb7fe32c1dadaf8b`
- Source CSV SHA-256: `1a6947e04785db63613a92e14903cdae7954f7e84860b10e68e5c7cbb3f9c3cf`
- Source file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skywind3000/ECDICT/bc015ed2e24a7abef49fc6dbbb7fe32c1dadaf8b/ecdict.csv
- Upstream license: MIT, reproduced below verbatim.
- Changes made on 2026-10-22: selected all cet4/gk-tagged entries; normalized
  three casing errors and two spellings; omitted the suspect proper-name entry
  cance; removed standalone domain-note lines from displayed meanings;
  marked beginner entries and selected 700 general-frequency-prioritized words.
- The application is independently written. It does not use assets, interfaces,
  logos, recordings, examples, or proprietary wordbooks from 百词斩 or 墨墨背单词.
